answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a sponsor-bonded jetty: each new identity must be vouched for by an already-staked agent and lock an onyx bond that is slashed if it double-votes. To mint fakes, an attacker needs a distinct sponsor and a fresh bond for every clone; hollow duplicates reusing one sponsor are caught and slashed together, so the cost of a majority rises linearly with each fake vote.
